title: Dashboard flow & backlog analytics
summary: Expose deterministic backlog flow, scope growth, throughput, and aging signals directly on the project dashboard.
description: Extend the existing dashboard composition in `packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/dashboard/route.tsx:23-67` and the current aggregate cards in `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/stat-cards.tsx:13-70` with a compact, deterministic Flow & Backlog analytics section. The current UI exposes total/done/remaining counts but cannot show whether scope is growing faster than work is closing. Derive analytics from task `createdAt`, `startedAt`, `completedAt`, current `status`, and `statusLog` fields defined in `packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts:203-254`, without loading or mutating external planner roots and without adding AI-generated claims. Deliver a 7/21/60 active-day selector (default 21), a textual summary and exact KPI table, Added vs Closed flow, cumulative Scope vs Completion, open-task aging, and optional data-point drill-down into the WorkTree in `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx:98+`. Define terminal statuses as done/canceled/rejected; treat planned/in-progress/blocked/waiting/deferred as open; include reopen events so net backlog equals added + reopened - closed. Use deterministic UTC day buckets and disclose that deleted tasks are absent from current persisted history. Preserve the dashboard's compact layout, existing filter behavior, responsive/mobile containment, current styling conventions, accessible non-color-only graph semantics, and bundle performance; prefer lightweight SVG/CSS over a heavy chart dependency. Dependencies: existing dashboard loader already provides features and phases. Behaviors to preserve: Project Goal, consolidated context, StatCards, Resume Required, WorkTree, latest-completed and new-added sections, scroll restoration, and Web UI supervisor semantics.

tasks.title: Build deterministic dashboard analytics model
tasks.description:
Create a pure analytics module for the dashboard, expected under `packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/dashboard-analytics.ts`, using the Feature/Phase/Task read models already consumed by `packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/dashboard/route.tsx:23-32`. Compute 7/21/60 active-day windows from task `createdAt`, terminal/open transitions in `statusLog`, `completedAt`, `startedAt`, and current status. Terminal statuses are done/canceled/rejected; open statuses are planned/in-progress/blocked/waiting/deferred. Net backlog must be added + reopened - closed, active days must use deterministic UTC buckets, and current open/total counts must remain independently verifiable. Return graph-ready daily points, cumulative scope/completion points, open-task aging buckets, summary rates, actual calendar range, and explicit data-quality limitations (especially deleted tasks not represented by current files and legacy history fallbacks). Preserve exact optional property handling and do not alter public core schemas or existing exported types. Add focused unit tests covering empty plans, sparse calendar activity, reopened tasks, terminal-to-terminal changes, status-log fallbacks, boundary timestamps, current open counts, aging buckets, and all three window sizes. No UI or styling changes belong in this task.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented and personally reviewed `packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/dashboard-analytics.ts` with deterministic UTC active-day analytics for 7/21/60-day windows, terminal/open/reopen event accounting, cumulative scope/completion and net backlog, current counts, rates, aging buckets, calendar ranges, explicit legacy/deleted-data limitations, and stable task-ID sets for later drill-down. Added `packages/plan-web-ui/test/dashboard-analytics.test.ts` with 26 focused cases covering empty and malformed data, sparse windows, reopen cycles, partial-history reconciliation, status transitions, UTC boundaries, as-of cutoffs, aging anchors, stable IDs, and all window sizes. Verification: Web UI TypeScript check passed; focused analytics tests passed 26/26; full Web UI suite passed 69/69 before the final malformed-timestamp regression and the final focused suite passed after it; `git diff --check` passed. No commit or push.

tasks.title: Render accessible backlog flow, burn-up, and aging graphs
tasks.description:
Extend the Flow & Backlog section created in T340 with three lightweight responsive visualizations driven by the T339 analytics model: (1) Added vs Closed grouped bars by active UTC day, with reopened/net information available without relying on color; (2) cumulative Scope vs Completion burn-up lines or areas where the visible gap represents open backlog; and (3) open-task aging buckets for 0–7, 8–14, 15–30, 31–60, and 60+ days. Implement with small local SVG/CSS components rather than introducing a heavy chart dependency, because the current Vite bundle already reports a large-chunk warning. Every graph must have a visible title, readable axes/labels, an accessible text summary or table, keyboard/focusable data points where interactive, non-color-only series identification, and stable empty/single-point behavior. On mobile, preserve horizontal containment and use a deliberate compact or horizontally scrollable presentation without changing unrelated dashboard layout. Add tests for rendering, labels, empty data, non-color semantics, the 21-point case, and responsive-safe structure.

---
**Completion summary:**
Added `analytics-charts.tsx` with three dependency-free, responsive analytics visualizations driven only by T339 outputs: grouped Added vs Closed bars, cumulative Scope vs Completion burn-up lines, and open-task aging buckets. Charts use lightweight local SVG/CSS, horizontally contained thin-scroll surfaces for long series, visible titles and axes, solid/striped and solid/dashed non-color series distinctions, semantic SVG titles/descriptions, and exact screen-reader tables. Empty and single/long-series behavior is bounded. Extended component tests for chart labels, non-color semantics, empty states, exact tables, aging buckets, 21-point width, and responsive containment. Verification: focused tests 8/8, Web UI TypeScript check passed, full Web UI suite 78/78, and git diff --check passed. No dependency, commit, or push.

tasks.title: Add analytics drill-down and complete browser verification
tasks.description:
Complete the P082 dashboard analytics experience by connecting summary or graph selections to the existing WorkTree in `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx:98+` without breaking its sort, search, Hide Done, Hide Planned, Only Active, expansion, locate, or persisted per-project view state. A selected active-day data point or KPI should expose the matching task set (added, closed, reopened, or currently open) through a clear reversible filter/drill-down, with an explicit Clear action and stable task IDs rather than title matching. Preserve React Router scroll behavior and avoid query-string updates that reset window position. Add end-to-end coverage in `e2e/status-dashboard.spec.ts` or a dedicated analytics spec using the real plan-server fixture and isolated temporary planner roots. Verify desktop and 390px touch/mobile containment, keyboard operation, data-point/table drill-down, empty analytics, and coexistence with Active tasks/Resume Required. Run the complete Web UI tests, production build, and Playwright suite. Do not change analytics definitions or unrelated WorkTree styling in this task unless a reviewed defect requires it.

---
